questions.Description: Install Python and develop a simple script that displays a welcome message for an industrial automation system on the screen.
Write a Python program to perform basic arithmetic operations for calculating production cost, profit, and tax in a manufacturing setup.
Implement a Python program to determine the largest of three machine parameters (e.g., motor load values) using if–elif–else statements.
Develop a Python program to create, append, and remove items from a production inventory list.
Write a Python program to find the maximum value from two sets of sensor readings stored in a list.
Create a Python program to concatenate and print strings representing product names in an assembly line.
Develop a Python program for row-wise addition of elements in a tuple matrix representing factory shift-wise production data.
Write a Python program to demonstrate creation and usage of dictionaries for storing and retrieving employee details in an organization.
Implement a Python program to read a log file and count the number of words/entries recorded during machine operation.
Develop a Python module containing utility functions, and import a specific function into another program for quality-check calculations.
Write a Python program to define a simple class (e.g., Machine) and create objects representing different machines in a plant.
Develop a Python program to design a simple GUI application for entering and displaying daily production reports.
